title.zh: AI发现3个安全漏洞后，比特币开发者紧急修复
title.en: Bitcoin developers rush to fix 3 security flaws after AI uncovers them

current_state.zh:
据CryptoSlate报道，一个AI系统在比特币协议代码中发现了三个安全漏洞，开发者随后迅速完成了修复。这些漏洞是在AI辅助下被发现的，并由负责该代码库的开发者进行了修补。

这一事件被视为一次双重示范：既体现了AI驱动漏洞研究对关键加密货币基础设施的价值，也暴露了其中的风险。
current_state.en: Bitcoin developers moved quickly to patch three security vulnerabilities in the protocol's code after an AI system identified them, highlighting both the value and the risks of AI-driven vulnerability research on critical cryptocurrency infrastructure.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitcoin developers moved quickly to patch three security vulnerabilities in the protocol's code after an AI system identified them, highlighting both the value and the risks of AI-driven vulnerability research on critical cryptocurrency infrastructure.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin developers moved quickly to patch three security vulnerabilities in the protocol's code after an AI system identified them, highlighting both the value and the risks of AI-driven vulnerability research on critical cryptocurrency infrastructure.
updates.background_zh: Bitcoin Core是比特币网络上大多数全节点使用的参考实现，该项目要求研究者通过 security@bitcoincore.org 私下报告漏洞，每份报告会被评定严重等级，随后记录在公开的安全公告中。该项目近期采用了结构化的公开披露政策，要求在补丁版本发布后经过一段既定等待期便公开记录相关问题，从而结束了此前悄然发布部分修复的做法。
updates.background_en: Bitcoin Core, the reference implementation used by most full nodes on the network, asks researchers to report vulnerabilities privately to security@bitcoincore.org, where each report is assigned a severity category before being documented in public security advisories. The project has recently adopted a structured public disclosure policy requiring issues to be documented and released after a defined waiting period following a patched release, ending the practice of quietly shipping some fixes.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道主要经由节点运行而非直接交易：由于Bitcoin Core支撑着大多数全节点和挖矿基础设施，节点运营者需要做出升级决策，这直接关系到网络的稳健性；而外界对共识层代码的任何疑虑都可能影响市场对比特币的情绪。相关漏洞已被修复，报道也未将其严重性或可利用性描述为造成实质损失的事件。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through node operations rather than trading directly: because Bitcoin Core underpins most full nodes and mining infrastructure, operators face upgrade decisions that touch network resilience, and any doubt about consensus-level code can weigh on sentiment toward the asset. The flaws were patched, and the report did not characterize severity or exploitability as material loss.
